audit.whatIsWrong: Chart rows 0, 2, 3 and 4 disagree with the packet and with their own whys[] text.
audit.why: Packet chart is Tryndamere, Skill, Tahm Kench, Tahm Kench, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere and it matches the whys[] exactly: 'You favour L1', 'Tahm favours L3', 'Tahm favours 4-5', 'You favour L6'. The side rows were the outliers on all four.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 to Tryndamere, rows 2 and 3 to Tahm Kench, as matched full/content pairs with ratings and reasons.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abyssal Dive is treated as the matchup-defining cooldown and described as 'his escape + shield'. It is neither.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is a 21/20/19/18/17s engage from 1000-1200 range that knocks up on arrival. His shield is Thick Skin, a 3s-cooldown conversion of stored damage into a shield — which is why chipping him feeds the shield. His lane spike is the three-stack Tongue Lash stun at 7s and 900 range; Devour joins only at 6. Undying Rage 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the engage/shield split written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has Tahm Kench's W and R swapped — 'Devour (W)' and 'Abyssal Dive (R)'. It also attributes the stacks to Tongue Lash alone and calls Thick Skin 'passive grey-health'.
audit.why: Devour is R, Abyssal Dive is W. An Acquired Taste stacks build from any damage he does to a champion, not from Tongue Lash specifically, and the stun fires when a Tongue Lash lands on a target already at three stacks — so the counterplay is breaking off at two and letting them decay. Thick Skin is an active on a 3s cooldown that converts stored damage into a shield: your chip damage is its fuel.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed, the stack mechanic restated as a stack-count read, and Thick Skin named as the thing your chip feeds.

audit.why: The mirror recorded that Devour holds for a few seconds against Undying Rage's 5, but whether Undying Rage can be cast while swallowed is a cast-inhibition question Riot's text does not answer. I wrote only the duration comparison, not a cast claim.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how Tahm Kench contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Spin up fury on the wave — Tahm Kench has one stack at most and no stun online yet, so the level-1 walk-up is yours.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Tahm Kench must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His window: three An Acquired Taste stacks turn Tongue Lash into a stun, so break off at two and let the stacks decay.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Abyssal Dive's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still his: Tongue Lash is 7s at rank 1 and Thick Skin regenerates whatever you chip. Trade only once your marks have fallen off.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Tahm Kench's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds, and Devour only holds you a few seconds, so level 6 hands the all-in back to you. Spend R on a kill, never on chip.

edits.before: Tahm favours 4-5 — his stun plus passive sustain and armour beat your commits while marked.
edits.after: Tahm favours 4-5 — the 3-stack stun plus Thick Skin's regen beat any commit you start marked.

edits.before: Tahm's window: with three Tongue Lash (Q) stacks he can proc a stun off his passive and eat your all-in, so never dive when you're at two grey-health stacks — walk out and reset the stack timer instead.
edits.after: Tahm's window: at three An Acquired Taste stacks his Tongue Lash (Q) stuns instead of slowing, so never commit while you are already marked twice — walk out, let the stacks decay, then go.

edits.before: Undying Rage flips the matchup back to you — he can't burst you through R, and Bloodlust out-heals his passive grey-health regen while you swing him down before he can Devour (W) away.
edits.after: Undying Rage flips the matchup back to you — he cannot burst through it, Bloodlust out-heals Thick Skin's regen, and Devour (R) only holds you a few seconds before you are swinging again.

edits.before: You out-splitpush Tahm all day, but respect his Devour (W) and Abyssal Dive (R) roam pressure — ward for his global and don't tunnel into a fight where he can eat you or a teammate.
edits.after: You out-splitpush Tahm all day, but respect Devour (R) — he can swallow a teammate out of your dive or eat you mid-commit, so never tunnel into a fight his ultimate decides.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are Tahm's: three Tongue Lash (Q) stacks proc his stun, and a stun into his sustain wins any trade you start, so don't all-in while you're marked. Wait for the stack to fall off, then commit.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are Tahm's: at three An Acquired Taste stacks Tongue Lash (Q) stuns you, and Thick Skin regenerates the chip, so never all-in while marked. Tongue Lash is 7s — trade around that.

edits.before: Use Devour (W) and Abyssal Dive (R) to disengage or roam onto other lanes
edits.after: Use Abyssal Dive (W) to engage and Devour (R) to swallow you mid-fight

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His escape + shield. Crit when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tongue Lash: 7s at rank 1, 900 range — it stuns only at three An Acquired Taste stacks, so break off at two. - Abyssal Dive is 21s and it engages, it does not escape. - Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive: His escape + shield. Crit when down. When it is down — Crit him down.
edits.after: Abyssal Dive is a 21s engage, not an escape; the shield is Thick Skin, and it is up every 3s.

edits.before: His escape + shield. Crit when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Abyssal Dive engages you from 1000 range on 21s — it is not his escape tool.

edits.before: That is Tahm Kench's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: At two stacks his next Tongue Lash stuns you — break off and let them decay.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Thick Skin converts the chip you deal into a shield every 3s.

notes: Tahm Kench's W and R were swapped in the content layer (Devour written as W, Abyssal Dive as R), and the full layer built its entire cooldown section around Abyssal Dive as 'his escape + shield' when it is a 21s engage and the shield is Thick Skin on 3s. The mirror flagged a champion-wide authoring error on the tahmkench side — 'stun into Devour' promised at levels 2-3 when Devour is his ultimate — worth the grep it suggests. Whether Undying Rage can be cast while swallowed by Devour is not in this data and I did not assert it.
